scenes.title: Snailax SL-256 or SL-233?
scenes.say: Snailax's two best selling chair massagers. The SL two fifty six for one nineteen ninety nine, or the SL two thirty three for one ninety nine ninety nine. Which one do you need?

scenes.title: Back massage on a budget
scenes.say: The SL two fifty six has four heated shiatsu nodes for your full, upper or lower back, plus seat vibration with three levels.

scenes.title: Adds a neck massager
bullets: Shiatsu or rolling on the back
scenes.say: The SL two thirty three adds four neck and shoulder nodes you can raise or lower, plus a rolling mode for the back. Snailax says it fits people about five foot three to five foot eleven.

scenes.title: Check the fine print
scenes.say: Heads up. Keep the box, because returns need the original packaging. Register within thirty days for a two year warranty. And keep sessions to about fifteen to twenty minutes.

scenes.title:
Back only → SL‑256
Neck too → SL‑233
